kroki.js: (function(){ const o=[...document.querySelectorAll('#lista-klientow option')].find(o => /Anna Nowak/.test(o.value)); if(!o) return 'brak podpowiedzi'; const i=document.getElementById('multi_klient'); i.value=o.value; i.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); i.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return o.value; })()

kroki.js: (function(){ const w=document.querySelector('#items-container .item-row'); const p=w.querySelector('.item-prod'); p.selectedIndex = p.options.length > 1 ? 1 : 0; p.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return p.value; })()

(function(){ const w=document.querySelector('#items-container .item-row'); const set=(sel,v)=>{ const e=w.querySelector(sel); if(!e) return 'brak '+sel; e.value=v; e.dispatchEvent(new Event('input',{bubbles:true})); e.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return sel+'='+e.value; }; const r=[set('.item-qty','1'), set('.item-unit-price','98.40'), set('.item-price','98.40')]; const pay=w.querySelector('.item-pay'); if(pay && pay.tagName==='SELECT'){ pay.selectedIndex = pay.options.length>1 ? 1 : 0; pay.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); r.push('pay='+pay.value); } const s=document.querySelector('#seller-grid .seller-chip'); if(s) s.click(); return r.join(' | ') + ' | suma: ' + (document.getElementById('total-sum')||{innerText:'?'}).innerText; })()

(function(){ const d=document.querySelector('#items-container .item-discount-select'); if(!d) return 'brak selectu rabatu w wierszu'; const o=[...d.options].find(o=>/Urodziny/i.test(o.textContent)); if(!o) return 'opcje rabatu: '+[...d.options].map(o=>o.textContent.trim()).join(', '); d.value=o.value; d.dispatchEvent(new Event('change',{bubbles:true})); return 'rabat: '+o.textContent.trim()+' → cena w wierszu: '+(document.querySelector('#items-container .item-price')||{}).value+' | suma: '+(document.getElementById('total-sum')||{innerText:'?'}).innerText; })()
